about_the_game:
Dive into the world of Medieval Survival to explore the mysteries of Lemuria and experience a unique combat system. Help the villagers free themselves from horrendous creatures that haunt their fields and villages to gain resources and powerful elemental abilities. Enjoy the unique story, missions and battles at all times. Download it for free and have your name engraved before the Gods.

An involving story

You are the last sorcerer of pure lineage who survived the great explosion caused by Malenius, the most powerful dark sorcerer of Lemuria. Your mission is to defeat him and restore chaos between Kingdoms. Your story starts now.

Combat system

Choose the style you want by invoking the 4 elements. The skill system adapts to different combat modes, be it melee or ranged.

Survival

Collect resources to create tools, structures and equipment. Develop unique abilities and upgrade your basic talents as you gain experience.
Survive waves of monsters that will seek to destroy you. Strengthen your structures and stay alert at all times

Trade

Trade between the different Kingdoms and create your own caravans and trading posts in the cities or villages. Increase the prosperity of settlements to increase profits and confidence with them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1060 3 GB or AMD RADEON RX 580 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

short_description: A corrupting mist spreads across the continent, turning humans and creatures hostile. Build, explore, and lead the last free settlement as you face relentless waves and uncover the origin of the darkness.
supported_languages:
Spanish - Latin America*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support
